uses.quote: Harassment, discrimination, or deceptive practices (e.g. deepfakes)

AI may be used to support preparation activities (e.g. drafting CVs, interview practice, and labour market research), provided its use enhances understanding and does not replace the development of a student’s own skills and judgement.

The use of AI to generate or substantially assist responses in live recruitment activities (including interviews, assessment centres, or timed tasks) is inappropriate unless explicitly permitted by the employer.
